struct GraphElement
    number::Union{Nothing,Int}
    pre::Set{Int}
    add::Set{Int}
    delete::Set{Int}
end
mutex_pair(a,b) = a < b ? (a,b) : (b,a)
function graph_conflict(a,b,mutexes)
    !isdisjoint(a.delete,union(b.pre,b.add)) || !isdisjoint(b.delete,union(a.pre,a.add)) ||
        any(mutex_pair(p,q) in mutexes for p in a.pre for q in b.pre)
end
function solve_graphplan(actions,initial,goal,limit)
    facts,mutexes = [initial],[Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}()]
    levels = Vector{GraphElement}[]
    exclusive_levels = Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}[]
    achiever_levels = Dict{Int,Vector{Int}}[]
    memo = Set{Tuple}()
    lines = String[]
    searched,memo_hits,tried = 0,0,0
    function extract(level,goals)
        level == 0 && return Vector{Int}[]
        key = (level,Tuple(goals))
        if key in memo
            memo_hits += 1
            return nothing
        end
        searched += 1
        layers = assign(level,goals,1,Int[])
        layers === nothing && push!(memo,key)
        layers
    end
    function assign(level,goals,position,chosen)
        elements = levels[level]
        while position <= length(goals) && any(goals[position] in elements[i].add for i in chosen)
            position += 1
        end
        if position > length(goals)
            previous = sort(collect(Set(p for i in chosen for p in elements[i].pre)))
            layers = extract(level-1,previous)
            layers === nothing && return nothing
            layer = sort([elements[i].number for i in chosen if elements[i].number !== nothing])
            push!(layers,Int.(layer))
            return layers
        end
        for i in achiever_levels[level][goals[position]]
            any(mutex_pair(i,j) in exclusive_levels[level] for j in chosen) && continue
            tried += 1
            layers = assign(level,goals,position+1,[chosen;i])
            layers === nothing || return layers
        end
        nothing
    end
    function finish(status,layers=Vector{Int}[])
        (status=status,plan=[n for layer in layers for n in layer],layers=layers,lines=lines,
            expanded=searched,generated=tried,memo_hits=memo_hits)
    end
    for level in 0:limit
        current,current_mutexes = facts[level+1],mutexes[level+1]
        push!(lines,"fact level $level: facts=$(length(current)) mutexes=$(length(current_mutexes))")
        ordered_goal = sort(collect(goal))
        possible = issubset(goal,current) && !any(mutex_pair(p,q) in current_mutexes for p in goal for q in goal if p < q)
        if possible
            before_search,before_hits = searched,memo_hits
            layers = extract(level,ordered_goal)
            outcome = layers === nothing ? "fail" : "success"
            push!(lines,"extract level $level: $outcome searched=$(searched-before_search) memo_hits=$(memo_hits-before_hits)")
            layers === nothing || return finish("solved",layers)
        elseif level >= 1 && length(current) == length(facts[level]) && length(current_mutexes) == length(mutexes[level])
            return finish("unreachable")
        end
        level == limit && return finish("level limit")
        elements = [GraphElement(a.number,a.pre,a.add,a.delete) for a in actions if issubset(a.pre,current) &&
            !any(mutex_pair(p,q) in current_mutexes for p in a.pre for q in a.pre if p < q)]
        action_count = length(elements)
        append!(elements,[GraphElement(nothing,Set([p]),Set([p]),Set{Int}()) for p in sort(collect(current))])
        exclusive = Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}()
        for i in eachindex(elements), j in (i+1):length(elements)
            graph_conflict(elements[i],elements[j],current_mutexes) && push!(exclusive,(i,j))
        end
        push!(lines,"action level $level: actions=$action_count noops=$(length(current)) mutexes=$(length(exclusive))")
        achievers = Dict{Int,Vector{Int}}()
        for (i,element) in enumerate(elements), p in element.add
            push!(get!(achievers,p,Int[]),i)
        end
        for producers in values(achievers)
            sort!(producers;by=i -> elements[i].number === nothing ? -1 : elements[i].number)
        end
        following = Set(keys(achievers))
        following_mutexes = Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}()
        ordered = sort(collect(following))
        for i in eachindex(ordered), j in (i+1):length(ordered)
            p,q = ordered[i],ordered[j]
            all(x != y && mutex_pair(x,y) in exclusive for x in achievers[p] for y in achievers[q]) &&
                push!(following_mutexes,(p,q))
        end
        push!(levels,elements)
        push!(exclusive_levels,exclusive)
        push!(achiever_levels,achievers)
        push!(facts,following)
        push!(mutexes,following_mutexes)
    end
    finish("level limit")
end

struct GroundAction
    number::Int
    source::Any
    arguments::Vector{String}
    cost::Int
    pre::Set{Int}
    neg::Set{Int}
    add::Set{Int}
    delete::Set{Int}
end
function subtype(parents,actual,expected)
    while actual !== nothing
        actual == expected && return true
        actual = parents[actual]
    end
    false
end
function predicate_classes(domain)
    fluent = Set(atom[1] for action in domain.actions for (_,atom) in action.effects)
    fluent,setdiff(Set(domain.predicate_order),fluent)
end
substitute(atom,assignment) = (atom[1],Tuple(assignment[term] for term in atom[2]))
function ground(domain,problem)
    objects_by_type = Dict(kind => [name for name in problem.object_order if subtype(domain.parents,problem.objects[name],kind)] for kind in domain.type_order)
    initial_atoms = Set(problem.initial)
    candidates,statistics = Any[],Dict{String,Vector{Int}}()
    for schema in domain.actions
        choices = [objects_by_type[kind] for (_,kind) in schema.parameters]
        statistics[schema.name] = [prod(length.(choices);init=1),0,0]
        function assign(arguments,index)
            if index <= length(choices)
                for name in choices[index]
                    assign([arguments;name],index+1)
                end
                return
            end
            binding = Dict(name => argument for ((name,_),argument) in zip(schema.parameters,arguments))
            positive,negative = Set{PlanningAtom}(),Set{PlanningAtom}()
            for (sign,atom) in schema.condition
                bound = substitute(atom,binding)
                if bound[1] == "="
                    truth = bound[2][1] == bound[2][2]
                elseif bound[1] in domain.static
                    truth = bound in initial_atoms
                else
                    push!(sign ? positive : negative,bound)
                    continue
                end
                truth == sign || return
            end
            adds = Set{PlanningAtom}(substitute(atom,binding) for (sign,atom) in schema.effects if sign)
            deletes = setdiff(Set{PlanningAtom}(substitute(atom,binding) for (sign,atom) in schema.effects if !sign),adds)
            push!(candidates,(source=schema,arguments=copy(arguments),cost=schema.cost,pre=positive,neg=negative,add=adds,delete=deletes))
            statistics[schema.name][2] += 1
        end
        assign(String[],1)
    end
    reachable = Set{PlanningAtom}(atom for atom in problem.initial if atom[1] in domain.fluent)
    accepted = Set{Int}()
    while true
        changed = false
        for (i,candidate) in enumerate(candidates)
            if !(i in accepted) && issubset(candidate.pre,reachable)
                push!(accepted,i)
                union!(reachable,candidate.add)
                statistics[candidate.source.name][3] += 1
                changed = true
            end
        end
        changed || break
    end
    predicate_order = Dict(name => i for (i,name) in enumerate(domain.predicate_order))
    object_order = Dict(name => i for (i,name) in enumerate(problem.object_order))
    facts = sort(collect(reachable);by=atom -> (predicate_order[atom[1]],Tuple(object_order[n] for n in atom[2])))
    fact_numbers = Dict(atom => i-1 for (i,atom) in enumerate(facts))
    actions = GroundAction[]
    for (i,candidate) in enumerate(candidates)
        i in accepted || continue
        mapped = [Set{Int}(fact_numbers[a] for a in values if haskey(fact_numbers,a))
            for values in (candidate.pre,candidate.neg,candidate.add,candidate.delete)]
        push!(actions,GroundAction(length(actions),candidate.source,candidate.arguments,candidate.cost,mapped...))
    end
    initial = Set{Int}(fact_numbers[a] for a in problem.initial if a[1] in domain.fluent)
    goal,unreachable = Set{Int}(),PlanningAtom[]
    for atom in problem.goals
        if haskey(fact_numbers,atom)
            push!(goal,fact_numbers[atom])
        elseif !(atom[1] in domain.static) || !(atom in initial_atoms)
            push!(unreachable,atom)
        end
    end
    action_numbers = Dict((a.source.name,Tuple(a.arguments)) => a.number for a in actions)
    (name=problem.name,source=problem,objects_by_type=objects_by_type,statistics=statistics,
        candidate_count=length(candidates),facts=facts,actions=actions,initial=initial,goal=goal,
        unreachable=unreachable,static_count=count(a -> a[1] in domain.static,problem.initial),action_numbers=action_numbers)
end

const HEURISTIC_NAMES = ["goalcount","hmax","hadd","ff","lmcount"]
const INFINITY = typemax(Int) ÷ 8
state_key(state) = Tuple(sort(collect(state)))
mutable struct HeuristicEngine
    problem::Any
    achievers::Vector{Vector{Int}}
    cache::Dict{Tuple,Any}
end
function new_evaluator(problem)
    achievers = [Int[] for _ in problem.facts]
    for action in problem.actions, fact in action.add
        push!(achievers[fact+1],action.number)
    end
    HeuristicEngine(problem,achievers,Dict{Tuple,Any}())
end
function relaxed_costs(engine,state,maximum_cost)
    get!(engine.cache,(maximum_cost ? "cmax" : "cadd",state_key(state))) do
        costs = [p-1 in state ? 0 : INFINITY for p in eachindex(engine.problem.facts)]
        while true
            changed = false
            for action in engine.problem.actions
                values = [costs[p+1] for p in action.pre]
                INFINITY in values && continue
                aggregate = maximum_cost ? maximum(values;init=0) : sum(values;init=0)
                value = action.cost+aggregate
                for p in action.add
                    if value < costs[p+1]
                        costs[p+1] = value
                        changed = true
                    end
                end
            end
            changed || break
        end
        costs
    end
end
function relaxed_plan(engine,state)
    get!(engine.cache,("plan",state_key(state))) do
        costs = relaxed_costs(engine,state,false)
        any(costs[g+1] == INFINITY for g in engine.problem.goal) && return nothing
        chosen = Set{Int}()
        pending = sort(collect(setdiff(engine.problem.goal,state)))
        while !isempty(pending)
            fact = pop!(pending)
            winner,lowest = -1,INFINITY
            for number in engine.achievers[fact+1]
                action = engine.problem.actions[number+1]
                values = [costs[p+1] for p in action.pre]
                INFINITY in values && continue
                value = action.cost+sum(values;init=0)
                if value < lowest
                    winner,lowest = number,value
                end
            end
            if !(winner in chosen)
                push!(chosen,winner)
                append!(pending,sort(collect(setdiff(engine.problem.actions[winner+1].pre,state))))
            end
        end
        sort(collect(chosen))
    end
end
function helpful(engine,state)
    plan = relaxed_plan(engine,state)
    plan === nothing ? Int[] : [n for n in plan if applicable(engine.problem.actions[n+1],state)]
end
function planning_levels(engine,state)
    get!(engine.cache,("levels",state_key(state))) do
        facts = [p-1 in state ? 0 : INFINITY for p in eachindex(engine.problem.facts)]
        actions = fill(INFINITY,length(engine.problem.actions))
        level = 0
        while true
            changed = false
            for action in engine.problem.actions
                actions[action.number+1] != INFINITY && continue
                any(facts[p+1] > level for p in action.pre) && continue
                actions[action.number+1] = level
                for p in action.add
                    if facts[p+1] == INFINITY
                        facts[p+1] = level+1
                        changed = true
                    end
                end
            end
            !changed && return facts,actions
            level += 1
        end
    end
end
function verified_landmark(engine,state,excluded)
    reachable = copy(state)
    while true
        changed = false
        for action in engine.problem.actions
            excluded in action.add && continue
            if issubset(action.pre,reachable)
                added = setdiff(action.add,reachable)
                if !isempty(added)
                    union!(reachable,added)
                    changed = true
                end
            end
        end
        changed || break
    end
    !issubset(engine.problem.goal,reachable)
end
function landmarks(engine,state)
    get!(engine.cache,("landmarks",state_key(state))) do
        fact_levels,action_levels = planning_levels(engine,state)
        any(fact_levels[g+1] == INFINITY for g in engine.problem.goal) && return nothing
        result = setdiff(engine.problem.goal,state)
        pending = sort(collect(result))
        verified = Dict{Int,Bool}()
        head = 1
        while head <= length(pending)
            fact = pending[head]
            head += 1
            earliest = [engine.problem.actions[n+1].pre for n in engine.achievers[fact+1]
                if action_levels[n+1] == fact_levels[fact+1]-1]
            candidates = copy(earliest[1])
            for pre in earliest[2:end]
                intersect!(candidates,pre)
            end
            for p in sort(collect(setdiff(candidates,union(state,result))))
                valid = get!(verified,p) do
                    verified_landmark(engine,state,p)
                end
                if valid
                    push!(result,p)
                    push!(pending,p)
                end
            end
        end
        result
    end
end
function heuristic_value(engine,name,state)
    name == "none" && return 0
    get!(engine.cache,(name,state_key(state))) do
        if name == "goalcount"
            return length(setdiff(engine.problem.goal,state))
        elseif name in ("hmax","hadd")
            costs = relaxed_costs(engine,state,name == "hmax")
            values = [costs[p+1] for p in engine.problem.goal]
            INFINITY in values && return INFINITY
            return name == "hmax" ? maximum(values;init=0) : sum(values;init=0)
        elseif name == "ff"
            plan = relaxed_plan(engine,state)
            return plan === nothing ? INFINITY : sum((engine.problem.actions[n+1].cost for n in plan);init=0)
        end
        selected = landmarks(engine,state)
        selected === nothing ? INFINITY : length(selected)
    end
end
heuristic_values(engine,state) = [heuristic_value(engine,name,state) for name in HEURISTIC_NAMES]

notation(atom) = "(" * join([atom[1];collect(atom[2])]," ") * ")"
action_text(action) = notation((action.source.name,action.arguments))
number_list(values) = isempty(values) ? "-" : join(sort(collect(values)),",")
headed(heading,items) = heading * " " * (isempty(items) ? "-" : join(items," "))
value_text(value) = value == INFINITY ? "inf" : string(value)
heuristic_text(values) = join([name * "=" * value_text(value) for (name,value) in zip(HEURISTIC_NAMES,values)]," ")
function read_settings(text)
    settings = Dict{String,Any}("runs" => Tuple{String,String}[])
    for row in split(text,'\n')
        (isempty(row) || startswith(row,"#")) && continue
        fields = String.(split(row))
        if fields[1] == "run"
            push!(settings["runs"],(fields[2],fields[3]))
        elseif fields[1] == "repair"
            settings["repair"] = (fields[2],fields[3])
        else
            settings[fields[1]] = parse(Int,fields[2])
        end
    end
    settings
end
function read_candidates(text)
    candidates = Any[]
    current = nothing
    for row in split(text,'\n')
        (isempty(row) || startswith(row,"#")) && continue
        if startswith(row,"plan ")
            fields = String.(split(row))
            current = (number=length(candidates)+1,problem=fields[2],label=fields[3],steps=Any[])
        elseif row == "end"
            push!(candidates,current)
        else
            fields = String.(split(row[2:end-1]))
            push!(current.steps,(fields[1],fields[2:end]))
        end
    end
    candidates
end
function argument_error(domain,arguments,expected,table,noun)
    length(arguments) == length(expected) || return "expected $(length(expected)) arguments, got $(length(arguments))"
    for (i,(argument,kind)) in enumerate(zip(arguments,expected))
        haskey(table,argument) || return "unknown $noun $argument"
        subtype(domain.parents,table[argument],kind) || return "argument $i ($argument) is not of type $kind"
    end
    ""
end
function validate_domain!(domain)
    kept,diagnostics = Any[],String[]
    for action in domain.actions
        error = ""
        for (_,kind) in action.parameters
            if !haskey(domain.parents,kind)
                error = "unknown type " * kind
                break
            end
        end
        if isempty(error)
            parameters = Dict(action.parameters)
            for (_,atom) in [action.condition;action.effects]
                if atom[1] != "=" && !haskey(domain.predicates,atom[1])
                    error = "unknown predicate " * atom[1]
                else
                    expected = atom[1] == "=" ? ["object","object"] : domain.predicates[atom[1]]
                    error = argument_error(domain,atom[2],expected,parameters,"variable")
                end
                if !isempty(error)
                    error = notation(atom) * ": " * error
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        isempty(error) ? push!(kept,action) : push!(diagnostics,"error: action $(action.name): $error")
    end
    domain.actions = kept
    domain.by_name = Dict(a.name => a for a in kept)
    used = Set(atom[1] for a in kept for (_,atom) in [a.condition;a.effects])
    for predicate in domain.predicate_order
        predicate in used || push!(diagnostics,"warning: predicate $predicate is not used by any action")
    end
    domain.fluent,domain.static = predicate_classes(domain)
    domain.diagnostics = diagnostics
end
function validate_problem!(domain,problem)
    for side in ("init","goal")
        original = side == "init" ? problem.initial : problem.goals
        kept,seen = PlanningAtom[],Set{PlanningAtom}()
        for atom in original
            error = haskey(domain.predicates,atom[1]) ?
                argument_error(domain,atom[2],domain.predicates[atom[1]],problem.objects,"object") :
                "unknown predicate " * atom[1]
            isempty(error) && atom in seen && (error = "duplicate")
            if isempty(error)
                push!(kept,atom)
                push!(seen,atom)
            else
                push!(problem.diagnostics,"warning: $side $(notation(atom)): $error")
            end
        end
        side == "init" ? (problem.initial = kept) : (problem.goals = kept)
    end
end
validation_result(status,messages,correct) = (status=status,messages=messages,correct=correct)
function validate_steps(domain,problem,steps)
    world,cost = Set(problem.initial),0
    for (i,(name,arguments)) in enumerate(steps)
        heading = "step $i $(notation((name,arguments))): "
        haskey(domain.by_name,name) || return validation_result("invalid",[heading * "unknown action " * name],i-1)
        schema = domain.by_name[name]
        error = argument_error(domain,arguments,last.(schema.parameters),problem.objects,"object")
        isempty(error) || return validation_result("invalid",[heading * error],i-1)
        binding = Dict(variable => argument for ((variable,_),argument) in zip(schema.parameters,arguments))
        for (sign,atom) in schema.condition
            bound = substitute(atom,binding)
            truth = bound[1] == "=" ? bound[2][1] == bound[2][2] : bound in world
            if truth != sign
                literal = sign ? notation(bound) : "(not " * notation(bound) * ")"
                return validation_result("invalid",[heading * "precondition " * literal * " is false"],i-1)
            end
        end
        deletes = Set(substitute(atom,binding) for (sign,atom) in schema.effects if !sign)
        adds = Set(substitute(atom,binding) for (sign,atom) in schema.effects if sign)
        setdiff!(world,deletes)
        union!(world,adds)
        cost += schema.cost
    end
    missing = ["unsatisfied goal " * notation(atom) for atom in problem.goals if !(atom in world)]
    isempty(missing) ? validation_result("valid",["length=$(length(steps)) cost=$cost"],length(steps)) :
        validation_result("goal not reached",missing,length(steps))
end
verdict(checked) = checked.status * (checked.status == "valid" ? " " : ": ") * checked.messages[1]
plan_steps(problem,plan) = [(problem.actions[n+1].source.name,problem.actions[n+1].arguments) for n in plan]
plan_cost(problem,plan) = sum((problem.actions[n+1].cost for n in plan);init=0)
function interferes(a,b)
    !isdisjoint(a.delete,union(b.pre,b.add)) || !isdisjoint(b.delete,union(a.pre,a.add)) ||
        !isdisjoint(a.add,b.neg) || !isdisjoint(b.add,a.neg)
end
function parallelize(problem,plan)
    assigned,layers = Int[],Vector{Int}[]
    for (j,n) in enumerate(plan)
        action,layer = problem.actions[n+1],1
        for i in 1:j-1
            previous = problem.actions[plan[i]+1]
            if !isdisjoint(previous.add,action.pre) || !isdisjoint(previous.delete,action.neg) || interferes(previous,action)
                layer = max(layer,assigned[i]+1)
            end
        end
        push!(assigned,layer)
        while length(layers) < layer
            push!(layers,Int[])
        end
        push!(layers[layer],n)
    end
    layers
end
function validate_parallel(problem,layers)
    state = problem.initial
    for (k,layer) in enumerate(layers)
        actions = [problem.actions[n+1] for n in layer]
        if any(!applicable(a,state) for a in actions) ||
            any(interferes(actions[i],actions[j]) for i in eachindex(actions) for j in (i+1):length(actions))
            return "invalid at layer $k"
        end
        deletes = Set{Int}(p for a in actions for p in a.delete)
        adds = Set{Int}(p for a in actions for p in a.add)
        state = union(setdiff(state,deletes),adds)
    end
    issubset(problem.goal,state) ? "valid" : "goal not reached"
end
function improve(problem,plan)
    sequence,position = copy(plan),1
    while position <= length(sequence)
        state = problem.initial
        for n in sequence[1:position-1]
            state = apply_action(problem.actions[n+1],state)
        end
        applied = Int[]
        for n in sequence[position+1:end]
            action = problem.actions[n+1]
            if applicable(action,state)
                state = apply_action(action,state)
                push!(applied,n)
            end
        end
        if issubset(problem.goal,state)
            sequence = [sequence[1:position-1];applied]
        else
            position += 1
        end
    end
    sequence
end
function transform_negatives(problem)
    negative = sort(collect(Set(p for a in problem.actions for p in a.neg)))
    complements = Dict(p => length(problem.facts)+i-1 for (i,p) in enumerate(negative))
    actions = GraphElement[]
    for a in problem.actions
        pre = union(a.pre,Set{Int}(complements[p] for p in a.neg))
        add = union(a.add,Set{Int}(complements[p] for p in a.delete if haskey(complements,p)))
        deletes = union(a.delete,Set{Int}(complements[p] for p in a.add if haskey(complements,p)))
        push!(actions,GraphElement(a.number,pre,add,deletes))
    end
    initial = union(problem.initial,Set{Int}(complements[p] for p in negative if !(p in problem.initial)))
    actions,initial,length(negative)
end
function domain_report(domain)
    lines = ["== domain $(domain.name) ==";domain.diagnostics]
    for kind in domain.type_order
        chain,current = String[],kind
        while current !== nothing
            push!(chain,current)
            current = domain.parents[current]
        end
        push!(lines,"type " * join(chain," < "))
    end
    for name in domain.predicate_order
        push!(lines,"predicate $name/$(length(domain.predicates[name])) " * (name in domain.fluent ? "fluent" : "static"))
    end
    for a in domain.actions
        adds = count(literal -> literal[1],a.effects)
        push!(lines,"action $(a.name)/$(length(a.parameters)) cost=$(a.cost) pre=$(length(a.condition)) add=$adds del=$(length(a.effects)-adds)")
    end
    lines
end
function grounding_report(domain,p)
    lines = ["";"== problem $(p.name) ==";p.source.diagnostics]
    push!(lines,"objects: $(length(p.source.objects))")
    append!(lines,[headed("  $kind:",p.objects_by_type[kind]) for kind in domain.type_order])
    push!(lines,"static facts: $(p.static_count)")
    for a in domain.actions
        assignments,candidates,reachable = p.statistics[a.name]
        push!(lines,"schema $(a.name): assignments=$assignments candidates=$candidates reachable=$reachable")
    end
    push!(lines,"candidates: $(p.candidate_count) reachable: $(length(p.actions))")
    push!(lines,"facts: $(length(p.facts)) init: $(length(p.initial)) goals: $(length(p.goal))")
    append!(lines,["unreachable goal: " * notation(a) for a in p.unreachable])
    counts = ["$name=$(count(a -> a[1] == name,p.facts))" for name in domain.predicate_order if name in domain.fluent]
    push!(lines,headed("facts by predicate:",counts))
    push!(lines,"facts:")
    append!(lines,["  $(i-1) $(notation(a))" for (i,a) in enumerate(p.facts)])
    push!(lines,"actions:")
    for a in p.actions
        push!(lines,"  $(a.number) $(action_text(a)) cost=$(a.cost) pre=$(number_list(a.pre)) neg=$(number_list(a.neg)) add=$(number_list(a.add)) del=$(number_list(a.delete))")
    end
    lines
end
function initial_report(p,engine)
    values = heuristic_values(engine,p.initial)
    selected = landmarks(engine,p.initial)
    selected === nothing && (selected = Set{Int}())
    relaxed = relaxed_plan(engine,p.initial)
    relaxed === nothing && (relaxed = Int[])
    lines = ["initial h: " * heuristic_text(values),"landmarks: $(length(selected))"]
    append!(lines,["  " * notation(p.facts[n+1]) for n in sort(collect(selected))])
    push!(lines,"relaxed plan: length=$(length(relaxed)) cost=$(value_text(values[4]))")
    append!(lines,["  " * action_text(p.actions[n+1]) for n in relaxed])
    push!(lines,headed("helpful:",[action_text(p.actions[n+1]) for n in helpful(engine,p.initial)]))
    lines,selected
end
function plan_report(domain,p,tag,plan,landmark_set,earlier)
    first_tag = get!(earlier,Tuple(plan),tag)
    suffix = first_tag == tag ? "" : " (same as $first_tag)"
    lines = ["plan: length=$(length(plan)) cost=$(plan_cost(p,plan))" * suffix]
    append!(lines,["  $i $(action_text(p.actions[n+1]))" for (i,n) in enumerate(plan)])
    counts = ["$(a.name)=$(count(n -> p.actions[n+1].source.name == a.name,plan))" for a in domain.actions
        if any(p.actions[n+1].source.name == a.name for n in plan)]
    push!(lines,headed("schemas:",counts))
    layers = parallelize(p,plan)
    push!(lines,"parallel: layers=$(length(layers))")
    append!(lines,[headed("  $i:",[action_text(p.actions[n+1]) for n in layer]) for (i,layer) in enumerate(layers)])
    improved = improve(p,plan)
    removed = length(plan)-length(improved)
    push!(lines,"improved: length=$(length(improved)) cost=$(plan_cost(p,improved)) removed=$removed")
    removed > 0 && append!(lines,["  $i $(action_text(p.actions[n+1]))" for (i,n) in enumerate(improved)])
    state,reached = p.initial,Set{Int}()
    for n in plan
        state = apply_action(p.actions[n+1],state)
        union!(reached,intersect(state,landmark_set))
    end
    push!(lines,"landmarks reached: $(length(reached))/$(length(landmark_set))")
    append!(lines,["  missed " * notation(p.facts[n+1]) for n in sort(collect(setdiff(landmark_set,reached)))])
    checked = validate_steps(domain,p.source,plan_steps(p,plan))
    checked_improved = validate_steps(domain,p.source,plan_steps(p,improved))
    validations = ["$tag: " * verdict(checked),"  parallel: " * validate_parallel(p,layers),"  improved: " * verdict(checked_improved)]
    lines,validations,checked.status == "valid"
end
function profile_report(p,engine,tag,plan)
    lines = ["-- profile ($tag) --"]
    state,remaining = p.initial,plan_cost(p,plan)
    overestimates = zeros(Int,length(HEURISTIC_NAMES))
    for k in 0:length(plan)
        values = heuristic_values(engine,state)
        push!(lines,"  $k: h*=$remaining " * heuristic_text(values))
        overestimates .+= values .> remaining
        if k < length(plan)
            a = p.actions[plan[k+1]+1]
            state = apply_action(a,state)
            remaining -= a.cost
        end
    end
    push!(lines,"overestimates: " * join(["$name=$value" for (name,value) in zip(HEURISTIC_NAMES,overestimates)]," "))
    push!(lines,"-- causal links ($tag) --")
    suppliers = Dict{Int,Int}()
    for (k,n) in enumerate(plan)
        a = p.actions[n+1]
        links = [notation(p.facts[f+1]) * "<-" * string(get(suppliers,f,0)) for f in sort(collect(a.pre))]
        push!(lines,headed("  $k $(action_text(a)):",links))
        for f in a.add
            suppliers[f] = k
        end
    end
    push!(lines,headed("  goal:",[notation(p.facts[f+1]) * "<-" * string(get(suppliers,f,0)) for f in sort(collect(p.goal))]))
    lines
end
function main()
    domain = read_domain(read("input/domain.txt",String))
    sources = read_problems(read("input/problems.txt",String))
    settings = read_settings(read("input/params.txt",String))
    candidates = read_candidates(read("input/candidates.txt",String))
    validate_domain!(domain)
    pairs = [settings["runs"];[("graphplan","none")]]
    tags = [algorithm == "graphplan" ? "graphplan" : "$algorithm $heuristic" for (algorithm,heuristic) in pairs]
    totals = [zeros(Int,4) for _ in tags]
    grounding_lines,plan_lines,graph_lines,validation_lines = domain_report(domain),String[],String[],String[]
    comparison = ["problem,algorithm,heuristic,length,cost,expanded,generated"]
    problems,evaluators,summaries = Dict{String,Any}(),Dict{String,Any}(),Dict{String,Any}()
    validated_plans,valid_plans = 0,0
    for source in sources
        validate_problem!(domain,source)
        p = ground(domain,source)
        problems[p.name] = p
        append!(grounding_lines,grounding_report(domain,p))
        for lines in (plan_lines,graph_lines,validation_lines)
            push!(lines,"== problem $(p.name) ==")
        end
        unreachable = !isempty(p.unreachable)
        engine = unreachable ? nothing : new_evaluator(p)
        landmark_set = Set{Int}()
        if unreachable
            push!(plan_lines,"initial h: unreachable goal")
        else
            evaluators[p.name] = engine
            lines,landmark_set = initial_report(p,engine)
            append!(plan_lines,lines)
        end
        outcomes,earlier,proof = Any[],Dict{Tuple,String}(),0
        for (i,(algorithm,heuristic)) in enumerate(pairs)
            complements = 0
            if unreachable
                outcome = search_result("unreachable goal")
            elseif algorithm == "graphplan"
                actions,initial,complements = transform_negatives(p)
                outcome = solve_graphplan(actions,initial,p.goal,settings["graphplan"])
            else
                outcome = run_search(p,p.initial,algorithm,heuristic,settings["budget"],settings["weight"],engine)
            end
            push!(outcomes,outcome)
            push!(plan_lines,"-- $(tags[i]) --")
            if unreachable
                push!(plan_lines,"result: FAIL (unreachable goal)")
            else
                status = outcome.status == "solved" ? "solved" : "FAIL ($(outcome.status))"
                push!(plan_lines,"result: $status expanded=$(outcome.expanded) generated=$(outcome.generated)")
                if outcome.status == "solved"
                    lines,validations,valid = plan_report(domain,p,tags[i],outcome.plan,landmark_set,earlier)
                    append!(plan_lines,lines)
                    append!(validation_lines,validations)
                    validated_plans += 1
                    valid_plans += valid
                end
            end
            if proof == 0 && (algorithm,heuristic) in [("ucs","none"),("astar","hmax")] && outcome.status == "solved"
                proof = i
            end
            if algorithm == "graphplan"
                if unreachable
                    push!(graph_lines,"result: FAIL (unreachable goal)")
                else
                    push!(graph_lines,"complementary facts: $complements")
                    append!(graph_lines,outcome.lines)
                    counts = " searched=$(outcome.expanded) memo_hits=$(outcome.memo_hits) tried=$(outcome.generated)"
                    if outcome.status == "solved"
                        push!(graph_lines,"result: solved levels=$(length(outcome.layers)) length=$(length(outcome.plan)) cost=$(plan_cost(p,outcome.plan))" * counts)
                        append!(graph_lines,[headed("layer $k:",[action_text(p.actions[n+1]) for n in layer]) for (k,layer) in enumerate(outcome.layers)])
                    else
                        push!(graph_lines,"result: FAIL ($(outcome.status))" * counts)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        proof != 0 && append!(plan_lines,profile_report(p,engine,tags[proof],outcomes[proof].plan))
        solved = [o for o in outcomes if o.status == "solved"]
        best = isempty(solved) ? nothing : minimum(plan_cost(p,o.plan) for o in solved)
        optimal = proof != 0 ? string(plan_cost(p,outcomes[proof].plan)) :
            any(o.status in ("unreachable goal","dead end","exhausted","unreachable") for o in outcomes) ? "none" : "unknown"
        summaries[p.name] = (solved=length(solved),best=best,optimal=optimal)
        for (i,(outcome,(algorithm,heuristic))) in enumerate(zip(outcomes,pairs))
            totals[i][3] += outcome.expanded
            totals[i][4] += outcome.generated
            if outcome.status == "solved"
                length_text,cost_text = string(length(outcome.plan)),string(plan_cost(p,outcome.plan))
                totals[i][1] += 1
                totals[i][2] += plan_cost(p,outcome.plan) == best
            else
                length_text,cost_text = "-","-"
            end
            push!(comparison,join([p.name,algorithm,heuristic,length_text,cost_text,outcome.expanded,outcome.generated],","))
        end
        for lines in (plan_lines,graph_lines,validation_lines)
            push!(lines,"")
        end
    end
    push!(plan_lines,"== summary ==")
    for source in sources
        s = summaries[source.name]
        best = s.best === nothing ? "-" : string(s.best)
        push!(plan_lines,"$(source.name): solved=$(s.solved)/$(length(tags)) best=$best optimal=$(s.optimal)")
    end
    for (tag,values) in zip(tags,totals)
        push!(plan_lines,"$tag: solved=$(values[1]) best=$(values[2]) expanded=$(values[3]) generated=$(values[4])")
    end
    push!(validation_lines,"== candidates ==")
    valid_candidates = 0
    for candidate in candidates
        p = problems[candidate.problem]
        checked = validate_steps(domain,p.source,candidate.steps)
        heading = "candidate $(candidate.number) $(candidate.problem) $(candidate.label): "
        map_steps(steps) = [p.action_numbers[(name,Tuple(arguments))] for (name,arguments) in steps]
        if checked.status == "valid"
            valid_candidates += 1
            push!(validation_lines,heading * verdict(checked))
            mapped = map_steps(candidate.steps)
            improved = improve(p,mapped)
            best = summaries[p.name].best
            best_text = best === nothing ? "-" : string(best)
            push!(validation_lines,"  improved: length=$(length(improved)) cost=$(plan_cost(p,improved)) removed=$(length(mapped)-length(improved)) best known=$best_text")
        else
            push!(validation_lines,heading * checked.status)
            append!(validation_lines,["  " * message for message in checked.messages])
            if !isempty(p.unreachable)
                push!(validation_lines,"  repair: FAIL (unreachable goal)")
                continue
            end
            prefix = map_steps(candidate.steps[1:checked.correct])
            state = p.initial
            for n in prefix
                state = apply_action(p.actions[n+1],state)
            end
            algorithm,heuristic = settings["repair"]
            outcome = run_search(p,state,algorithm,heuristic,settings["budget"],settings["weight"],evaluators[p.name])
            if outcome.status != "solved"
                push!(validation_lines,"  repair: FAIL ($(outcome.status))")
            else
                repaired = [prefix;outcome.plan]
                validation = validate_steps(domain,p.source,plan_steps(p,repaired))
                push!(validation_lines,"  repair: kept=$(length(prefix)) added=$(length(outcome.plan)) " * verdict(validation))
                append!(validation_lines,["    $i $(action_text(p.actions[n+1]))" for (i,n) in enumerate(repaired)])
            end
        end
    end
    append!(validation_lines,["","== summary ==","plans: $validated_plans valid: $valid_plans",
        "candidates: $(length(candidates)) valid: $valid_candidates"])
    mkpath("output")
    for (name,lines) in [("grounding.txt",grounding_lines),("plans.txt",plan_lines),("graphplan.txt",graph_lines),
        ("validation.txt",validation_lines),("comparison.csv",comparison)]
        write(joinpath("output",name),join(lines,"\n") * "\n")
    end
end
main()

const PlanningAtom = Tuple{String,Tuple{Vararg{String}}}
mutable struct PlanningDomain
    name::String
    parents::Dict{String,Union{Nothing,String}}
    type_order::Vector{String}
    predicates::Dict{String,Vector{String}}
    predicate_order::Vector{String}
    actions::Vector{Any}
    by_name::Dict{String,Any}
    fluent::Set{String}
    static::Set{String}
    diagnostics::Vector{String}
end
mutable struct ProblemSource
    name::String
    objects::Dict{String,String}
    object_order::Vector{String}
    initial::Vector{PlanningAtom}
    goals::Vector{PlanningAtom}
    diagnostics::Vector{String}
end
function expressions(text)
    cleaned = join([split(row,';';keepempty=true)[1] for row in split(text,'\n')],"\n")
    tokens = [String(m.match) for m in eachmatch(r"\(|\)|[^ ()\n]+",cleaned)]
    position = 1
    function read_expression()
        token = tokens[position]
        position += 1
        token != "(" && return token
        items = Any[]
        while tokens[position] != ")"
            push!(items,read_expression())
        end
        position += 1
        items
    end
    roots = Any[]
    while position <= length(tokens)
        push!(roots,read_expression())
    end
    roots
end
function typed_list(words)
    result,pending = Pair{String,String}[],String[]
    position = 1
    while position <= length(words)
        if words[position] == "-"
            append!(result,[name => String(words[position+1]) for name in pending])
            empty!(pending)
            position += 2
        else
            push!(pending,String(words[position]))
            position += 1
        end
    end
    append!(result,[name => "object" for name in pending])
    result
end
parse_atom(expression) = (String(expression[1]),Tuple(String.(expression[2:end])))
function conjuncts(expression;empty=true)
    conjunction = expression[1] == "and" && all(x -> x isa Vector,expression[2:end])
    conjunction && (empty || length(expression) > 1) ? expression[2:end] : [expression]
end
function parse_literal(expression)
    negative = expression[1] == "not" && length(expression) == 2 && expression[2] isa Vector
    negative ? (false,parse_atom(expression[2])) : (true,parse_atom(expression))
end
function read_domain(text)
    expression = expressions(text)[1]
    domain = PlanningDomain(expression[2][2],Dict("object" => nothing),["object"],
        Dict{String,Vector{String}}(),String[],Any[],Dict{String,Any}(),Set{String}(),Set{String}(),String[])
    for section in expression[3:end]
        if section[1] == ":types"
            for name in section[2:end]
                if name != "-" && !haskey(domain.parents,name)
                    domain.parents[name] = "object"
                    push!(domain.type_order,name)
                end
            end
            for (name,parent) in typed_list(section[2:end])
                domain.parents[name] = parent
            end
        elseif section[1] == ":predicates"
            for declaration in section[2:end]
                name = String(declaration[1])
                domain.predicates[name] = [kind for (_,kind) in typed_list(declaration[2:end])]
                push!(domain.predicate_order,name)
            end
        elseif section[1] == ":action"
            fields = Dict(section[i] => section[i+1] for i in 3:2:length(section))
            condition = haskey(fields,":precondition") ? parse_literal.(conjuncts(fields[":precondition"])) : Any[]
            effects,cost = Any[],1
            for item in conjuncts(fields[":effect"];empty=false)
                if item[1] == "increase" && length(item) == 3 && item[2] == ["total-cost"]
                    cost = parse(Int,item[3])
                else
                    push!(effects,parse_literal(item))
                end
            end
            push!(domain.actions,(name=String(section[2]),parameters=typed_list(fields[":parameters"]),
                condition=condition,effects=effects,cost=cost))
        end
    end
    domain
end
function read_problems(text)
    problems = ProblemSource[]
    for expression in expressions(text)
        sections = Dict(section[1] => section[2:end] for section in expression[3:end])
        objects = typed_list(sections[":objects"])
        push!(problems,ProblemSource(expression[2][2],Dict(objects),first.(objects),
            parse_atom.(sections[":init"]),parse_atom.(conjuncts(sections[":goal"][1];empty=false)),String[]))
    end
    problems
end

applicable(action,state) = issubset(action.pre,state) && isdisjoint(action.neg,state)
apply_action(action,state) = union(setdiff(state,action.delete),action.add)
search_result(status,expanded=0,generated=0,plan=Int[]) = (status=status,expanded=expanded,generated=generated,plan=plan)
mutable struct SearchNode
    state::Set{Int}
    g::Int
    depth::Int
    parent::Int
    action::Int
end
function heap_push!(heap,entry)
    push!(heap,entry)
    i = length(heap)
    while i > 1
        parent = i ÷ 2
        heap[parent][1] <= entry[1] && break
        heap[i] = heap[parent]
        i = parent
    end
    heap[i] = entry
end
function heap_pop!(heap)
    first = heap[1]
    last = pop!(heap)
    if !isempty(heap)
        i = 1
        while 2*i <= length(heap)
            child = 2*i
            child < length(heap) && heap[child+1][1] < heap[child][1] && (child += 1)
            last[1] <= heap[child][1] && break
            heap[i] = heap[child]
            i = child
        end
        heap[i] = last
    end
    first
end
function search_priority(algorithm,g,depth,h,weight)
    algorithm == "bfs" && return depth
    algorithm == "ucs" && return g
    algorithm == "gbfs" && return h
    g+h*(algorithm == "wastar" ? weight : 1)
end
function best_first(problem,start,algorithm,heuristic,budget,weight,engine)
    initial_h = heuristic_value(engine,heuristic,start)
    initial_h == INFINITY && return search_result("dead end")
    nodes = [SearchNode(start,0,0,0,-1)]
    heap = [((search_priority(algorithm,0,0,initial_h,weight),initial_h,0),1)]
    best = Dict(state_key(start) => 0)
    serial,expanded,generated = 1,0,0
    reopen = algorithm in ("ucs","astar","wastar")
    while !isempty(heap)
        _,index = heap_pop!(heap)
        node = nodes[index]
        reopen && node.g > best[state_key(node.state)] && continue
        if issubset(problem.goal,node.state)
            plan = Int[]
            while nodes[index].parent != 0
                push!(plan,nodes[index].action)
                index = nodes[index].parent
            end
            return search_result("solved",expanded,generated,reverse(plan))
        end
        expanded == budget && return search_result("budget",expanded,generated)
        expanded += 1
        for action in problem.actions
            applicable(action,node.state) || continue
            state = apply_action(action,node.state)
            generated += 1
            cost,key = node.g+action.cost,state_key(state)
            haskey(best,key) && (!reopen || best[key] <= cost) && continue
            best[key] = cost
            h = heuristic_value(engine,heuristic,state)
            h == INFINITY && continue
            child = SearchNode(state,cost,node.depth+1,index,action.number)
            push!(nodes,child)
            heap_push!(heap,((search_priority(algorithm,cost,child.depth,h,weight),h,serial),length(nodes)))
            serial += 1
        end
    end
    search_result("exhausted",expanded,generated)
end
function hill_climbing(problem,start,heuristic,budget,engine)
    current,plan = start,Int[]
    current_h = heuristic_value(engine,heuristic,current)
    expanded,generated = 0,0
    current_h == INFINITY && return search_result("dead end")
    while !issubset(problem.goal,current)
        queue = [(state=current,path=Int[])]
        visited = Set([state_key(current)])
        head,improved = 1,false
        while head <= length(queue) && !improved
            entry = queue[head]
            head += 1
            expanded == budget && return search_result("budget",expanded,generated)
            expanded += 1
            for number in helpful(engine,entry.state)
                state = apply_action(problem.actions[number+1],entry.state)
                generated += 1
                key = state_key(state)
                key in visited && continue
                push!(visited,key)
                h = heuristic_value(engine,heuristic,state)
                h == INFINITY && continue
                path = [entry.path;number]
                if h < current_h
                    append!(plan,path)
                    current,current_h,improved = state,h,true
                    break
                end
                push!(queue,(state=state,path=path))
            end
        end
        improved || return search_result("stuck",expanded,generated)
    end
    search_result("solved",expanded,generated,plan)
end
function run_search(problem,start,algorithm,heuristic,budget,weight,engine)
    algorithm == "ehc" ? hill_climbing(problem,start,heuristic,budget,engine) :
        best_first(problem,start,algorithm,heuristic,budget,weight,engine)
end
